blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday launched hotlines for the public to report verifiable information on the whereabouts of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, who has been wanted by the International Criminal Court (ICC) since November last year. The move followed Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla’s announcement last Friday of a P50-million bounty for the senator’s capture. READ: P50-M bounty for capture of ‘armed and dangerous’ Bato Dela Rosa – DILG In a press conference, PNP public information chief Col. Allen Rae Co presented the following hotline numbers: Co said the numbers would be available 24/7 starting Wednesday. […]...
